phase1_assignment.objective: Audit generic reproducible agent-lifecycle patterns for durable evidence, provenance, continuation, verification and handoff of only irreducible exclusive actions.

observations.mechanism: authorization-gate credit requires activation/coverage evidence, and public physical-science reporting can quantify the automatic path without quantifying the manual-path mix
observations.evidence: The trapped-ion ARTIQ safety-gate paper reports 631 legitimate calibration scripts approved with zero false rejection, a red-team set of 1,932 scripts plus approximately 250 harness-level tests, per-call exact-content token binding, automatic dax.sim plus device-bound checks for routine actions, and block-by-default/manual review for sensitive or indeterminate actions. The paper does not report a manual-vs-automatic authorization activation fraction or a matched always-human comparison; it explicitly leaves A/B comparisons and long unattended-incidence evaluation for future work.
observations.scope: Direct physical-science evidence for automatic-gate coverage and exclusive manual authorization structure on trapped-ion hardware. It does not establish a quantitative manual-token activation rate or causal efficiency gain from authority-minimal handoff.

observations.mechanism: the published cached-authorization design closes policy changes only by explicit operator invalidation, not automatic policy-revision binding
observations.evidence: For byte-identical scripts the trapped-ion system may reuse stored approval. The paper states that the stored approval does not expire automatically and that tightening safety bounds requires the operator to invalidate affected approvals because the filter does not determine which cached entries became stale. A public source-code project URL is named, but its file tree was not retrievable through the available public transport in this invocation; the paper says remaining supporting data are available from the corresponding author on request.
observations.scope: Observed limitation of this system's cache lifecycle. Supports a generic policy-revision freshness invariant, but no machine-readable automatic invalidation implementation was verified from public code in this invocation.

observations.mechanism: cross-domain failure-memory reuse can be dual-faced: useful on one target and strongly harmful on another when governing assumptions differ
observations.evidence: The official Negative Knowledge reproduction appendix evaluates four Burgers-NLS tasks under NoKB, BKdV-only cross-domain memory, NLS domain-matched memory, and NLS+BKdV. Aggregate PASS counts are 0/4, 2/4, 3/4 and 3/4 respectively. On T_B, the BKdV-only condition reached 0.005% of requested simulation time versus NoKB's 0.7%, a 140x degradation. The repository's entry-level audit traces the failure to a BKdV positive spectral-method record that the agent transferred into a target sign convention where the corresponding primitive formulation is UV anti-diffusive. The same record provided useful method-family guidance on a different target, while target-matched NLS memory supplied the missing structural warning and avoided the T_B trap.
observations.scope: Matched numerical mathematical-physics evidence for transfer risk in these PDE tasks. The 140x effect is not generalized to wet-lab or all scientist agents.

inferences.proposal: Classify handed failure memory as same_domain, cross_domain, or domain_general. A cross-domain record is a bounded hypothesis, not authority: source success/failure cannot itself authorize a target action.

Before adopting cross-domain failure memory, require explicit mechanism/assumption compatibility plus a bounded target-side probe, and bind that qualification to a digest of the current target context so changed target assumptions invalidate stale revalidation.

Keep raw failed/abandoned branches immutable and addressable for provenance, derive a bounded typed record for normal handoff, require receiver adopt/reject/hold, and permit a record to constrain the action set only after explicit adoption and any required revalidation.

unverified_claims: No matched physical-science study was verified in this invocation that isolates authority-minimal handoff against always-human approval while holding model, task and tools constant.
The trapped-ion paper does not report a public manual-vs-automatic token activation fraction; automatic-path coverage counts must not be misreported as a deployment mix.
The named Duke GitLab source project could not be inspected beyond project-level availability through the current transport, so an implementation-level cache invalidation strategy remains unverified.
The failure-memory relevance gate is a protocol synthesis from the Negative Knowledge transfer counterexample; its own causal benefit has not yet been isolated in a matched scientist-agent ablation.
